integrity: Analytic proof is primary. A standalone SciPy verification script provides finite numerical corroboration. No independent mathematical review or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The computed threshold is exactly the Euclidean-ball-versus-opposite-simplex comparison, not the universal simplex-optimality transition. The high-dimensional expansion does not assert an optimal global competitor. Historical priority is provisional and specialized older symmetric-convolution literature may contain an equivalent comparison.
title: Sharp Euclidean-ball obstruction to simplex optimality for convolution bodies
